coordination_negative_result: Parallel GO workers can collide on unusual-experiment accounting and shared frontiers. Equivalent valid implementations must not become parallel canonical paths: PR #663 was closed after #660 landed; CM-02 production duplicates #664, #667 and #673 were closed after fusion into #681. Distinct pair-revisit, cache-taint and diagnostic-expansion observations were preserved as research evidence. Pull-request workflows that directly execute candidate repository bytes on persistent self-hosted runners are not trusted merely because they assert github.event.pull_request.head.sha: exact provenance and source-admission/isolation are separate requirements. CM-07 corrective work converted its direct resolver/package-index self-hosted gates to fail-closed skipped markers and exposed clayenv-minimal.yml as another candidate-byte execution surface. Workspace writes use compare-and-swap and must fuse rather than overwrite concurrent updates.
